notes: Operating-facts snapshot researched 2026-10-14; latest verified opening included: Tongyunmen, 2026-06-30. Not a live service feed.
Coordinates derived from OpenStreetMap (WGS84); the schematic is original. Data database © OpenStreetMap contributors, available under ODbL 1.0; application code and artwork are separately licensed.
Line 1–Batong and Line 4–Daxing run through without a forced interchange. Capital Airport Express uses the directed terminal circuit.
Bajiao Amusement Park is non-stopping and omitted; deferred Hongmiao / Gaojiayuan on Line 14 and Guangqumenwai on Line 17 are not invented.

Muxidi Line 1/16 and the tram links at Bagou / Rongchang Dongjie remain separate nodes. Explicit external walking links require exiting/re-entering; their times/distances are illustrative game estimates, not verified accessibility or paid-area transfers.

Map-only positions interpolated for 12 unmatched stations: 石厂 (s1), 小园 (s1), 栗园庄 (s1), 上岸 (s1), 桥户营 (s1), 四道桥 (s1), 朱房北 (changping), 颐和园西门 (xijiao), 茶棚 (xijiao), 万安 (xijiao), 国家植物园 (xijiao), 香山 (xijiao). Positions are illustrative, not precise geographic navigation.
Line colors are original approximate identity colors. Times, crowding, walking, wheelchair suitability, toilets and incidents are game simulations, not verified facilities or real travel advice.
